usage: 燒鴨飯 is a noun referring to a dish consisting of roast duck served with rice.
It can be used as a subject or object in a sentence, for example, '我想食燒鴨飯' means 'I want to eat roast duck rice.'
When ordering food, you can simply say 燒鴨飯 to tell the waiter what you want.
It is a countable dish, so you can say 一碗燒鴨飯 to mean 'a bowl of roast duck rice.'
You can combine 燒鴨飯 with adjectives to describe the taste or style, such as 好味嘅燒鴨飯 (delicious roast duck rice).
